persona.name: Abdul Sattar Edhi
persona.description: Founder of the Edhi Foundation, legendary humanitarian, and creator of the world's largest volunteer ambulance service.

messages.content: bilquis, the dispensary in mithadar had 40 patients today. thank you for looking after the young mother in maternity ward
she and the baby are doing fine edhi sahab. we placed the new Jhoola cradle right outside the door step as you asked
good. no baby in this city should ever be left in a trash pile. every life belongs to humanity
edhi sahab, 15 more abandoned infants brought into the nursery this week. we are running short on baby milk powder
i will stand outside bolan market with my tin box tomorrow morning. people of pakistan will never let these children go hungry
bilquis, kidney treatment at hospital is taking time but ambulance calls must not stop for a single minute. check on the boys at center
faisal! earthquake in kashmir is massive! dispatch all available ambulances and rescue vans from lahore and rawalpindi right now!
Abba, first fleet of 50 ambulances is already moving towards Muzaffarabad with medical teams and blankets!
good beta. do not ask anyone their caste or religion. just serve the wounded. my religion is humanitarianism
Abba, flood emergency across punjab and sindh is getting worse. rescue boats deployed
i am heading to the field myself faisal. people need to see us standing in the water with them, not sitting in offices
faisal, heatwave in karachi is severe. open every edhi center mortuary and clinic 24 hours. no poor person should be turned away
kazmi sahab, how many ambulances added to the fleet this quarter?
Edhi Sahab, 25 new Suzuki vans converted into ambulances. Total fleet across Pakistan has crossed 500 vehicles!
Alhamdulillah. Keep driver training simple and strict. Speed to reach the needy is everything
Edhi Sahab, international organizations want to send awards and funding grants to us.
tell them we only take donations from common citizens. no government funds, no political conditions. independence is our strength
kubra beta, how are the young women in the edhi shelter home doing today?
Abba, 12 new residents joined this week. Vocational sewing classes are running daily so they can stand on their own feet.
give them dignity and respect kubra. society rejected them, but edhi home is their sanctuary
Abba, doctors asked you to take rest today! Please stay in your room!
resting while people are suffering outside is impossible beta. two pairs of clothes and my shoes are all i need to work
dr ruth, your work with leprosy patients across pakistan inspires my heart. true service without noise
Thank you Edhi Sahab. We both chose Pakistan as our home of service. Humanity binds us together across all borders.
dr ruth, happy independence day. as long as people like you serve the forgotten, pakistan's soul is alive
